description: The Coldwater Sentinel's back door, beside the loading dock where its van backs in: a steel door under a lamp, stencilled NO PARKING, and a roller shutter over the dock. Through a wired window, a wall of feed-screens flickers through headlines, and a printer inside never stops chattering. The paper's front is on Marrow Street, on the far side of the building and the wall.
name: Coldwater Sentinel
